_comment: Site pages with a known copy on dev.to, Hashnode or Medium, from the platform inventories taken 9 Oct 2026. syndication:build writes these by default; syndication:sync does not need this list, because it reads each post's canonical. Add a page here when you cross-post it.
_medium_comment: Medium copies with no "Originally published at" footer: Medium URL slug prefix -> the site page it copied (resolved through _redirects). The Stocky Shutdown post copied /stocky-shutdown/, which now 301s to /stocky-alternative/.
